intro: A world frozen in fear and shadows
description:
Something is wrong with time… and you are trapped inside it.
In A Little Horror Story, you follow a young boy who wakes up in a broken world where reality no longer behaves as it should. Shadows move on their own, environments shift without warning, and fragments of the past repeat in strange and unsettling ways.

Explore a series of dark and atmospheric locations, from silent forests frozen in time to ruined structures caught in endless loops. Each area presents new puzzles and dangers, forcing you to observe carefully and think before every move.
Use unique time-based mechanics to interact with the world around you. Slow down moving objects, restore broken paths, and manipulate unstable environments to progress through each challenge. Every puzzle is connected to how you understand and control time.

Some dangers cannot be fought — only avoided. Timing, awareness, and patience are your only tools.
As you move forward, fragments of the story begin to reveal the truth behind the world and your connection to it. Nothing is explained directly — everything must be discovered.

Key Features:
- Atmospheric 2.5D platformer with puzzle elements
- Time manipulation mechanics that shape gameplay
- Exploration across multiple unique environments
- Environmental puzzles based on logic and timing
- Dark narrative told through discovery

Move carefully, observe everything, and trust nothing.
In A Little Horror Story, time is not your ally.
